spots.name: Orenburg Higher Military Aviation School for Pilots
spots.summary: The I. S. Polbin Orenburg Red Banner Higher Military Aviation School for Pilots was a flight training school of the Soviet Air Force, located in the city of Orenburg. One of the oldest flight schools in the air force, the school was established in Moscow in 1921, and moved to Orenburg in 1927.

spots.summary: The Embassy of the Emirate of Bukhara in Orenburg is a culturally significant building in Orenburg, Orenburg Oblast, Russia. It is a registered historic monument with the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation. The house was built for the Emir of Bukhara.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Orenburg Regional Museum of Fine Arts is an art museum located in Orenburg, Russia. It was opened to the public in 1961. The gallery houses a collection of Soviet, Russian, and Western European art, and was initially predicated on a collection of Lukian Popov works.

Husainia Mosque, Orenburg

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Husainia Mosque is a historic mosque in Orenburg, Russia. Built in 1892 near the madrasah of the same name, it was initiated and financed by the Tatar merchant of the first guild, Akhmed-bay Khusainov. The architect was presumably D. P. Korin.
